title: Customer Success Manager, Growth
description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires.

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 40,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

We’re looking for a Customer Success Manager to help manage relationships with Linear’s top customers. As a part of the early team, you’ll play a pivotal role in laying the foundation and setting up best practices. You will champion our customers’ needs and ensure they realize the full value of Linear across their organization. Your role will involve onboarding new customers, delivering ongoing support + enablement, and fostering strong relationships to drive customer satisfaction and retention.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Develop and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders at Linear’s mid-market customers - act as the primary point of contact for customer inquiries, concerns, and feedback

 - Become a product expert and help customers use Linear to drive business outcomes

 - Drive customer onboarding and training on Linear’s features and best practices; continually strive to expand the usage and adoption of Linear within accounts

title: Head of Financial Operations, Japan
description:
Block is one company built from many blocks, all united by the same purpose of economic empowerment. Our products and services, including Square, Cash App, Afterpay, TIDAL, Bitkey, and Proto, help millions of people around the world access, manage, and move money with more flexibility and control. We believe everyone should be able to participate and thrive in the economy, and we build tools that make commerce and financial services more accessible.
 Block’s Financial Operations team is responsible for the movement of money through our bank partners, card networks, payment partners, and internal platforms. The team’s mission is to ensure our customers’ experience taking payments, completing sales, settling funds, and getting paid is reliable, efficient, compliant, and cost effective. To deliver on that mission, Block operates within a complex and highly regulated ecosystem of financial institutions, payment networks, industry partners, regulatory requirements, and internal systems. Financial Operations plays an integral role in shaping the infrastructure, controls, partner relationships, and operational capabilities required to support Square’s long term growth in Japan.
 As Head of Financial Operations, Japan, you will lead Square’s financial operations strategy in the market. You will own critical payment and banking partner relationships, strengthen operational resilience and controls, and ensure Square can scale reliably in Japan. This Tokyo based hybrid role requires deep payments expertise, strong commercial judgment, and the ability to influence senior internal and external stakeholders.
 The Role
 In this role, you will translate Square Japan’s Financial Operations strategy into measurable outcomes. You will work across payments, product, operations, partnerships, and regulatory engagement to improve performance, support new capabilities, and help Square grow in a complex and highly regulated market.

title: Founding Product & Solutions Engineer (m/f/d)
description:

 We are looking for a technically strong, curious and proactive person who enjoys solving unfamiliar problems and working directly with customers.

 Experience with enterprise software, SAP or ERP systems, supply chain, logistics or industrial environments is an advantage.

 • Work directly with the founding team

title: Senior Product Manager - Human AI Collaboration (all genders)
description:
We're looking for someone to own Human Understanding & Adaptive Collaboration as one of wingmaite's four foundational product disciplines. This isn't a traditional product role, you won't simply manage features or execute roadmaps. You'll define how wingmaite understands humans and collaborates with them, building the discipline through which experts externalize knowledge that only they currently hold.
 Tasks
 What you'll do
 Enterprise Knowledge Elicitation: Define how wingmaite interviews experts, asks follow-up questions, reconstructs decisions and surfaces tacit knowledge
 Adaptive Collaboration: Decide when the system should ask, explain, interrupt, remind, wait, or deliberately not infer
 Collaboration Conditions: Model the situation, not the person: authority, expertise, timing, necessary friction
 Human Understanding Integrity: Establish what the product may legitimately learn about a person in context, and what it must deliberately leave unmodeled
 Challenge the CPO, CTO and Engineers on questions inside your pillar as one of four intellectual owners at the company
 Turn deep thinking into product behavior that's measurable and useful
 Build toward a small team, starting as a strong individual contributor
 What this role is explicitly not
 HR tech. Employee analytics. Performance management. Personality profiling. Engagement optimization. Prompt engineering. Traditional UX research. wingmaite models conditions, not characteristics. No scoring people, no manipulating behavior, no inferring personality, no replacing human judgment.
 Requirements
 Must-haves
 Background in AI product, human-computer interaction, cognitive science, knowledge engineering, learning sciences, human factors, behavioral design, or enterprise software
 Exceptional product judgment and experimental thinking
 Think in situations, decisions, authority, expertise, and conditions, not fixed user traits
 Real ethical restraint: You know when a system should not infer something, even…

title: Vertriebscontroller im Bankenumfeld (m/w/d)
description:
Im Auftrag unseres Partnerunternehmens in München suchen wir Sie zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt als „Vertriebscontroller im Bankenumfeld (m/w/d)“.
 Aufgaben
 Als Vertriebscontroller im Bankenumfeld (m/w/d) erstellen Sie datenbasierte Reports, Kundenpotenzial-Analysen und Forecasts, um die Vertriebsstrategie zu stärken
 Dabei überwachen Sie Vertriebskennzahlen, analysieren Soll-Ist-Abweichungen und unterstützen bei der Zielerreichung
 Sie beraten das Vertriebsmanagement strategisch bei der Definition relevanter Handlungsfelder und begleiten Zielplanungsprozesse
 Außerdem liefern Sie kontinuierlich Steuerungsdaten und KPI-Analysen zur Optimierung des Vertriebserfolgs
 Sie sind verantwortlich für die technische und inhaltliche Betreuung der Vertriebs- und Erfolgserfassungssysteme inklusive Workflow-Optimierung und Datenintegration
 Qualifikation
 Sie bringen eine Ausbildung zum Bankkaufmann (m/w/d), Sparkassenkaufmann (m/w/d), eine Weiterbildung zum Bankfachwirt (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation im Bereich Controlling/Vertrieb mit
 Sie verfügen über fundierte Erfahrung im Vertriebscontrolling, Datenanalyse und Reporting, idealerweise im Sparkassen- oder Bankenumfeld
 Idealerweise haben Sie sicher im Umgang mit Datenbanken, BI-Tools oder ERP-Systemen gearbeitet und Erfahrung mit Vertriebssystemen gesammelt
 Sie arbeiten analytisch, strukturiert und ergebnisorientiert; Ihre Kommunikationsstärke, Teamfähigkeit und Kundenorientierung zeichnen Sie aus
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse zeichnen Sie aus

 Langfristige Jobmöglichkeit: Das Unternehmen sucht langfristige Unterstützung im Rahmen einer unbefristeten Festanstellung
